title: Simple Variable Mass 3dof (Wind Axes)
text: 实现相对于风轴的简单变质量三自由度运动方程，输入 6 路、输出 9 路；按 {Mass type} 指定质量类型 Simple；{Units}、{Axes}、{Initial airspeed}、{Initial flight path angle}、{Initial body rotation rate}、{Initial incidence}、{Initial position (x,z)}、{Initial mass}、{Empty mass}、{Full mass}、{Empty inertia body axes}、{Full inertia body axes}、{Gravity Source}、{Acceleration due to gravity}、{Include mass flow relative velocity}、{Limit mass flow when mass is empty or full}、{Include inertial acceleration}、{Velocity: e.g., ’V’}、{Position: e.g., ’Xe’, ’Ze’}、{Body rotation rate: e.g., ’q’}、{Flight path angle: e.g., ’gamma’}、{Incidence angle e.g., ’alpha’}、{Mass: e.g., ’mass’} 同样影响行为。

ports.name: F x
ports.summary: 沿风 x 轴施加的力 scalar

ports.name: F z
ports.summary: 沿风 z 轴施加的力 scalar

ports.name: V w
ports.summary: 风固定坐标系中的速度 two-element vector

params.name: Units
params.values: 输入和输出单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Axes
params.values: 机体轴或风轴 Wind (default) | Body

params.name: Mass type
params.values: 质量类型 Simple Variable (default) | Fixed | Custom Variable

params.name: Initial airspeed
params.values: 初始速度 100 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial flight path angle
params.values: 初始航迹角 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial body rotation rate
params.values: 初始俯仰旋转速率 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial incidence
params.values: 初始角度 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial position (x,z)
params.values: 初始位置 [0 0] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Initial mass
params.values: 初始质量 1.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Empty mass
params.values: 燃料箱为空时的机体质量 0.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Full mass
params.values: 燃料箱已满时的机体质量 3.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Empty inertia body axes
params.values: 燃料箱为空时的机体惯性 0.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Full inertia body axes
params.values: 燃料箱已满时的机体惯性 3.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Gravity Source
params.values: 重力来源 Internal (default) | External

params.name: Acceleration due to gravity
params.values: 重力来源 9.81 (default) | scalar

params.name: Include mass flow relative velocity
params.values: 质量流相对速度端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Limit mass flow when mass is empty or full
params.values: 限制质量流 on (default) | off

params.name: Include inertial acceleration
params.values: 包括惯性加速度端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Velocity: e.g., ’V’
params.values: 速度状态名称 ’’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Position: e.g., {’Xe’, ’Ze’}
params.values: 位置状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Body rotation rate: e.g., ’q’
params.values: 机体旋转状态名称 ’’ (default) | scalar

params.name: Flight path angle: e.g., ’gamma’
params.values: 航迹角状态名称 ’’ (default)

params.name: Incidence angle e.g., ’alpha’
params.values: 入射角状态名称 ’’ (default) | scalar

params.name: Mass: e.g., ’mass’
params.values: 质量状态名称 ’’ (default) | scalar
